name: roi_xz_inherit_xonly_tuning_b2000
description: ROI X+Z paired VCTR bootstrap using hyperparameters inherited from the selected X-only model.
notes: S, R, h, and hbar are inherited from the selected ROI X-only prediction model; they are not X+Z-optimal hyperparameters.
Patients are sampled by manifest subject_id; all visits and both eyes are retained.
CP features, response transformation, Z transformation, and inherited hyperparameters remain fixed.
A(t) and beta use 95% pointwise/parameterwise percentile bootstrap confidence intervals.
